root_causes: Machine component term shaft was incorrectly inferred as a hard operating domain.
Compound must_not_show 'coal power plant' could reject generic power-plant candidates without coal evidence.
A multi-object fallback query could omit the primary required subject, e.g. S3 'turbine shaft' omitted generator and S5 'residential homes' omitted power lines.
Commons lexical retrieval is materially better for residential houses than residential homes.
Relevant Commons HAER photographs can have image/tiff originals while providing safe JPEG thumbnails; M8 downloads the thumbnail but previously skipped the source by original MIME.

fix.compound_must_not: Multi-token exclusions require at least one distinctive non-generic forbidden modifier in metadata in addition to the existing concept threshold.
fix.scoped_missing_primary: Only provider_query is enriched when a multi-object fallback omits primary subject; storyboard query/query_text stays immutable.
fix.machinery_fallback: For missing-primary machinery fallback, reuse at most one specific qualifier from the scene's first query as retrieval-only context; never promote it to hard domain.
fix.residential_alias: Provider retrieval normalizes residential home(s) to residential houses; scorer treats home and house as semantic equivalents.
fix.wikimedia_tiff: Allow image/tiff origin only when Commons supplies a JPEG/PNG/WebP thumburl; download remains the web-raster thumbnail.
